numinance.kinds.v1.BundleQuery.jsonschem.description: BundleQuery is one search: the tool, the digest of its arguments, how many results it returned and whether it was cut.

args_digest.description: args_digest is required: the digest of the canonical arguments, never the arguments.

results.description: results is the number of results returned.

tool.description: tool is required: the tool name as the connection pins it.

truncated.description: truncated is true when the results were cut at a cap.

numinance.kinds.v1.BundleQuery.jsonschem.title: Bundle Query

numinance.types.v1.Digest.jsonschema.str.description: Digest is a sha256 content digest as "sha256:" plus 64 lowercase hex characters.

value.description:
value is exactly "sha256:" plus 64 lowercase hex characters. Any other
 length, case or prefix, and an empty value in a present message, is
 rejected. Absence is the unset message.

numinance.types.v1.Digest.jsonschema.str.title: Digest
